# Script inputs

Run this from the repo root, the folder that holds `docs/`. `<interpreter> scripts/design_run.py [--root <specs repo>] [--headless] <move> ... --vendor copilot`, where the interpreter is `py -3` on Windows and `python3` elsewhere (`crav1-docs/reference/running-scripts.md`). Exit 2 means refused; the reason is on stderr and nothing was written. `docs/architecture/designs/<topic>/inputs/` holds only the user's own saved goal files. Scratch input (`ending`, `lean`, `settle`, `stage`, `compare`, `compare-topics`) goes in the session's temp folder; those moves refuse an input file in `inputs/` (1.190.0). `create` and `change-goal` refuse unknown keys by name; a `notes` key (text, a list or an object) is saved to the topic's `notes.md` with `note`.

- `create --topic <topic> [--builds-on <base>] --input goal.json`: `ask`, `end_goal`, `drivers`, `constraints`, `criteria`, `design`, `design_title`, `decisions` (titles in order, or `{"title": ..., "detail": true}` for a detail decision), `notes`. It creates `design/<topic>` when it is missing (from `design/<base>` with `--builds-on`), refuses with the switch card instruction when that branch exists and is not checked out, and returns `branch_state` (and `kit_check` when the kit files differ). Each decision gets `Order: N`. An input in `inputs/` is recorded under `## Applied inputs` in `goal.md`. With `--builds-on` the base topic folder must have no uncommitted files. With `--builds-on` it also returns `branch_from`, `git` (the branch commands), `update_from_base` and `fixed`.
- `change-goal --topic --input change.json --reason "<why>" [--yes]`: any of `ask`, `end_goal`, `drivers`, `constraints`, `criteria`, `decisions` (the new order; a missing one is dropped), `renames` (`{old: new}`), `drop_reasons` (`{title: reason}`), `reopen` (titles). Without `--yes` it writes nothing and returns `old`, `new`, `changes`, `flagged`, `dropped`. With `--yes` it rewrites each decision's `Order: N` and records the input under `## Applied inputs`; an input from outside `inputs/` is copied there as `goal-change-<n>.json`. Never with `--headless`.
- `revisit --topic <linked topic> --decision "<words>" --reason "<why>"`: marks the base topic's decision reopened and returns its `ending`.
- `status [--topic]`, `resume --topic [--design] [--json] [--skip-kit-check]` (returns `kit_check`, and `pending_goal_inputs` for saved goal files in `inputs/` not yet applied; when the branch's kit is behind the default branch's it writes nothing and returns `branch_sync`; `--json` prints the field payload and leaves Status as it is, parked included; a source that changed still marks that decision reopened, 1.201.1), `park --topic [--design]`, `reopen --topic` (an ended session is open again and the status screen is printed), `review --topic [--design]`.
- `add-decision --topic --title "<decision>" [--detail]`: gets the next `Order: N`.
- `switch-branch --topic [--yes]`: returns the switch `card`; `--yes` runs `git switch design/<topic>` and refuses, naming the paths, when the working tree is dirty. Never with `--headless`.
- `commit --topic [--message] [--yes]`: lists the uncommitted files in the topic folder with a `card`; `--yes` commits them as `Design <topic>: <message>`. Never with `--headless`.
- `note --topic --title "<title>" [--kind scan|vision|scope|answers|goal|other] (--text "..." | --input note.json)`: `text` (a string) or `items` (a list); appends to `notes.md` in the topic folder.
- `branch-behind --topic [--yes]` (global `--no-fetch`): is `design/<topic>` behind the default branch (`origin/HEAD`, else `origin/main`, then `origin/master`) or, for a linked topic, `design/<base>`? Returns `state`, `behind`, `card`, `ending` and `default_branch`, or `skipped` with the reason when there is no default branch; `--yes` merges each with `git merge --no-ff` after the user's yes, never with `--headless`, and on a conflict merges nothing and names the files. `resume`, `fan-out`, `stage`, `go-ahead`, `change-goal` and `create` on an existing design branch add the same check as `branch_sync`.
- `linked-behind --topic <base> [--yes]`: lists linked topics (from the committed `goal.md` on each `design/*` branch) whose branch is behind `design/<base>`, with `behind`, `card` and `ending`. `--yes` needs a clean working tree and the user's one yes; it merges `design/<base>` into each with `git merge --no-ff`, switches back, and on a conflict stops there, names the files and leaves the rest (`merged`, `untouched`, `conflict`). Never with `--headless`. `ending` on a base topic adds a `Behind design/<base>: ...` line.
- `small-fix --topic [--design] --text "<fix>"`: lists a change with no design choice under `## Small fixes`.
- `lean --topic --decision "<words>" --input lean.json`: `options` (each `name`), `recommended`, `leaning`, `drivers`, `ideas`. `drivers` names drivers already listed, by their short name; a short name that matches the start of a listed driver is not added again, and only a truly new driver is appended. The names are kept on the decision as `Drivers:`.
- `settle --topic --decision "<words>" --input settle.json [--revisit-yes]`: `chosen`, `options` (each `name`, `good`, `bad`, `not_chosen`, `yours`), `why`, `drivers`, `context`, `adr_title`, `deciders`, `end_state`, `diagram` (Mermaid), `sources` (paths a resume should watch), `reverses`, `scores`.
- `question --topic --text "<question> (who)" [--decision] [--kind research --research <topic>] [--stage]`; `answer --topic --question "<words>" --text "<answer>"`; `skip --topic --decision "<words>"`.
- `fan-out --topic --name <name> --mode copy|blank [--title]`.
- `stage --topic --input stages.json`: `stages`, each `name`, `reason`, optional `waits_on`.
- `compare --topic [--input]`: `scores` as `{design: {criterion: yes|partly|no}}`.
- `compare-topics --topics <a> <b> --asked --input`: `criteria`, `scores`.
- `go-ahead --topic [--design] [--slice <slug>] [--accept-findings] [--base-merged]`.
- `ending --topic --input state.json`: `phase` (`design`, `go-ahead`, `merged`), `parked` and `open` and `no_slice` and `routed_requirement` and `question_open` (true or false), `slices` (a list of slugs), `research_topic` and `reason` (text), `waiting` (text for one line, or a list for one `Waiting:` line per item), `uncommitted` (a count; a list of paths is counted, and true is counted from git status of the topic folder; text is refused), printed as `Uncommitted: N files.`, `builds_on` and `idea` (prints `/crav1-design-architecture builds-on <base> <idea>`).

Decisions and questions are found by their words, never by number.
